title: Non-Surgical Face Contouring: Filler or Laser Lifting?
h1: Non-surgical face contouring: filler or laser lifting?
desc: How to contour the face without surgery: when face filler is the answer, when Nd:YAG laser lifting is better, and how the two work together. Prices at Skin & Laser Dubai Marina.
answer: Face contouring without surgery uses two main tools. Filler restores lost volume and shape in the cheeks, jawline and chin, from AED 900 + VAT. Nd:YAG laser lifting warms the deeper skin of the face and neck to firm it, from AED 999 + VAT, with no downtime. Many patients combine both for structure and firmer skin.
facts: Volume and shape, from AED 900 + VAT
body:
A defined face comes from two things: good structure underneath and firm skin on top. With age we lose both. Non-surgical face contouring treats each one with the right tool.

## When filler is the answer

If the face looks flatter, the cheeks have dropped or the jawline has lost its edge, the problem is mostly volume. [Face filler](/treatments/face-filler-dubai/) replaces that volume with hyaluronic acid gel, placed by a doctor:

- Cheeks, to lift the mid-face
- Jawline and chin, to sharpen the profile
- Temples and under-eyes, to soften hollows

For a stronger jawline our Texas treatment uses 3 ml of Teosyal Ultra Deep. For the whole face, a liquid face lift uses 5 to 7 ml in one plan.

## When laser lifting is better

If the shape is still good but the skin looks loose, thin or crepey, the problem is mostly skin quality. [Nd:YAG laser lifting](/treatments/laser-skin-tightening-dubai/) uses gentle passes of 1064 nm laser light to warm the deeper skin of the face and neck and stimulate collagen. There is no downtime, and skin becomes firmer over a series of sessions.

## Why many people combine both

Filler rebuilds structure; laser lifting improves the skin that covers it. Together they give a more natural, lasting contour than either alone. Your doctor usually starts with the main concern and adds the other where it helps. See all options on our [face contouring page](/face-lifting-dubai/).

## What about deeper lifting?

For more visible sagging of the brows, jawline or neck, ultrasound lifting may suit you better. Read about our [face lifting treatments](/face-lifting-dubai/).

## Prices in Dubai Marina

At Skin & Laser Juvederm, Teosyal and Stylage cost AED 1,950 + VAT, Skinfill AED 900 + VAT, Texas AED 2,900 + VAT and a liquid face lift AED 7,000 + VAT. Nd:YAG laser lifting starts at AED 999 + VAT.

Can filler and laser be done on the same day?
Often yes, but your doctor may space them depending on the areas treated.
Not when the plan is built gradually by an experienced doctor. We aim for a natural result.
Which is better for a double chin?
It depends on the cause. A doctor checks whether it is fat, loose skin or a weak chin before suggesting filler, laser or another treatment.
